verdict.rationale: MX documents several data products, including Instant Account Verification, Account Owner Identification, balances, Account Aggregation and Extended Transaction History. Each is described as connecting to the end user's institution, and the connectivity overview points to a single Connect Widget/Platform API connection layer built around a persistent, auto-aggregated `member`. That suggests one connection can serve several products, but no evidence explicitly says a single connect session powers auth, balances, transactions and identity at once without re-prompting the user. Missing for 10: explicit docs that one member/connection can feed multiple products without separate flows, guidance on adding products to an existing connection, and hands-on or independent confirmation.
